description: DEWALT's 30cm Cordless Chain Saw is engineered to deliver instant and precise cuts on various wooden and tile surfaces. BATTERIES & CHARGER SOLD SEPARATELY. This BARE TOOL from DEWALT operates with high torque force to offer a smoother cutting action. Delivering up to 70 cuts per charge on a 5Ah battery in 4x4€ pressure treated spruce. Featuring a 30cm Oregon Bar and Chain, the DCM565 is equally effective at cutting logs as it is trimming timber beams in confined spaces. This chain saw is compatible with 18V XR (20V Max) Li-ion batteries that deliver an optimum speed and torque for cutting. High efficiency Brushless motor, delivering up to 70 x 4x4” cuts of pressure treated spruce per charge using an 18V XR 5Ah battery. This cordless chain saw is ideal for professional and DIY cutting applications. It is convenient for cutting branches on trees as it allows the user to operate without wires. Chain speed of 7.68 m/s. plus a chain brake that stops in <1 second for improved safety. 2 Year warranty offered on the product from the date of purchase. The product is manufactured by Stanley Black & Decker with registered trademarks.
